description: This file contains utility methods for data transformation and calculations, including postal code sanitization, weight unit conversions, and measurement conversions, specific to the sales manager application.

classes.name: DataUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for postal code cleaning, weight and measurement conversions.

methods.name: trimPostalCode
methods.description: Removes all non-alphanumeric characters from the postal code.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Converts weight between units based on store configuration and desired base unit.

methods.name: getMeasure
methods.description: Converts measurements between units (inches to centimeters or vice versa) based on store configuration and desired base unit.
